paragraphs: The decisive missing measurement is an endogenous state between injury input and regenerative output. No basal-epidermal state corresponding to the proposed intervening variable $P$ has been identified in the supplied stage-40 versus stage-46 evidence. An upstream sensor would still measure input, while a downstream reporter retains the persistence ambiguity. A test must first name and localize a candidate, establish assay specificity and temporal resolution, calibrate its measurement kinetics independently in each stage, and corroborate its trajectory with an orthogonal assay. Calling either endpoint $P$ would not fill this gap. [C11, C13]

Effective input must be shown to have ended. Stopping external delivery or washing medium does not establish intracellular cessation without measurements or justified bounds. Exposure validation must cover local peak, duration, shape, and localization; equal delivered dose alone is insufficient. Timing comparisons must distinguish time since amputation, time since pulse, and absolute wound age. Matched post-pulse delays and matched wound ages answer different questions. Sham and vehicle controls, viability, wound size, closure, and tissue composition help test whether treatment injury or altered wound progression explains an apparent effect. [C13]

A discriminating observation would be faster corrected candidate-state decay at stage 46 than at stage 40 after matched effective input has ended, confirmed by an orthogonal endogenous-state assay. That would support a candidate-specific persistence difference over the restricted explanation of common decay with stage-dependent measurement filtering. A precise result excluding a prespecified faster-decay effect would oppose the designated hypothesis; an imprecise null result would be inconclusive. Neither result eliminates unrestricted hidden-state or combined-gating alternatives. [C13]

Persistence alone would not establish causal mediation of regeneration. A later intervention would have to change the candidate's persistence while separating that change from exposure, toxicity, tissue composition, pulse-time inducibility, and direct effects on the downstream epidermal program. A downstream bypass paired with early-signal perturbation could help locate the failure. Even an apparent pulse rescue would not identify the mediator by itself; ruling out a useful rescue requires uncertainty bounds after the intended persistence change has been verified. [C13]

The biological unit must be established before individual-level inference. The supplied GSE245320 pointers do not verify specimen-to-library links, animals versus pools, time pairing, replication, batch structure, or specimen-linked regeneration outcomes. Original sample and assay records are needed. Verified pools permit pool-level inference, not independent-animal claims from their constituent cells. Later prediction would require linked individual measurements and outcomes, and literature novelty remains unassessed. [C12, C13]

A separate pilot would estimate between-animal and between-clutch variation and justify the minimum interesting effect and sample size. Confirmation should fix response definitions, allocation, thresholds, uncertainty calculations, and stopping rules in advance. A predictor would need held-out biological-unit evaluation against stage-only, cell/extracellular-matrix-only, and known-signaling baselines at matched information and prediction horizons, followed by independent functional confirmation. No numerical biological effect, held-out gain, or independent functional result is established here. [C12, C13]

Later recovery of competence needs its own prediction and a verified later-competent X. laevis condition; a stage-40 versus stage-46 contrast, or a pattern in X. tropicalis, does not supply it. The current result is a boundary on what would make shortened signal memory testable: candidate-specific persistence must be separated from continued input and measurement dynamics. It is neither evidence that the memory mechanism exists nor evidence that it is absent. [C11, C12, C13]
